headline: Nearly 100k students affected: Chattogram board suspends HSC exams indefinitely
summary: The decision follows severe flooding in the region and ongoing student protests demanding the education minister's resignation.
details: The Chattogram Education Board has suspended all remaining Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) examinations for 2026 until further notice.
A total of 99,688 students from 283 colleges across five districts—Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Rangamati, Khagrachhari, and Bandarban—are affected by the suspension.
The board cited the post-flood situation, damaged roads making travel to centers difficult, and the physical and mental wellbeing of examinees as primary reasons for the decision.
This move follows a resolution by the Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee and consultations with relevant stakeholders.
Previously, the board had suspended exams until July 16 due to heavy rainfall and flooding in the region.
The suspension also comes amid ongoing student demonstrations in front of the board office over the past two days, demanding the resignation of the education minister.
A revised examination schedule will be announced through a separate notice at an appropriate time.
caption:

The board cited the post-flood situation, damaged roads making travel to centers difficult, and the physical and mental wellbeing of examinees as primary reasons for the decision.

This move follows a resolution by the Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee and consultations with relevant stakeholders.

Previously, the board had suspended exams until July 16 due to heavy rainfall and flooding in the region.

The suspension also comes amid ongoing student demonstrations in front of the board office over the past two days, demanding the resignation of the education minister.

A revised examination schedule will be announced through a separate notice at an appropriate time.

headline_marked: Fitness concerns: [[Yamal and Porro train separately]] ahead of World Cup final
headline: Fitness concerns: Yamal and Porro train separately ahead of World Cup final
summary: Spain's Lamine Yamal and Pedro Porro are undergoing precautionary workload management as they prepare for Sunday's clash against Argentina.
details: Lamine Yamal and Pedro Porro trained separately from the rest of the Spanish squad on Thursday in New Jersey, as they prepare for the World Cup final against Argentina.
The Spanish football federation (RFEF) stated that the separate training is a precautionary measure for workload management and both players are expected to be available for Sunday's match.
Pedro Porro is reportedly dealing with a hamstring strain, though the problem is not considered serious. Coach Luis de la Fuente had previously mentioned Porro was carrying a knock.
Lamine Yamal's situation is less concerning, as he is nursing aches and bruises following a demanding semi-final match against France.
Spain's priority is to ensure the entire squad is as fresh as possible for the final, especially as they adjust to the high heat and humidity of New Jersey.
The rest of the squad trained in temperatures around 30 degrees Celsius, remaining upbeat and relaxed despite the challenging weather conditions.
caption:
Will Spain's key stars be fit for the final? Yamal and Porro are training separately as the countdown to Sunday's clash begins.

Lamine Yamal and Pedro Porro trained separately from the rest of the Spanish squad on Thursday in New Jersey, as they prepare for the World Cup final against Argentina.

The Spanish football federation (RFEF) stated that the separate training is a precautionary measure for workload management and both players are expected to be available for Sunday's match.

Pedro Porro is reportedly dealing with a hamstring strain, though the problem is not considered serious. Coach Luis de la Fuente had previously mentioned Porro was carrying a knock.

Lamine Yamal's situation is less concerning, as he is nursing aches and bruises following a demanding semi-final match against France.

Spain's priority is to ensure the entire squad is as fresh as possible for the final, especially as they adjust to the high heat and humidity of New Jersey.

The rest of the squad trained in temperatures around 30 degrees Celsius, remaining upbeat and relaxed despite the challenging weather conditions.
